AI Engineer

Experience: 2-4 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Mode: Coimbatore / Hybrid

About the role
We are looking for an AI Engineer to design, build and deploy LLM-powered products.

Key Responsibilities
- Build and deploy applications using Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI.
- Design Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines with vector databases such as Pinecone, FAISS or Weaviate.
- Develop AI agents and multi-agent workflows using LangChain, LlamaIndex or LangGraph.
- Fine-tune open-source models (Llama, Mistral) using LoRA / QLoRA and Hugging Face.
- Apply prompt engineering and evaluate model outputs; monitor quality in production.
- Build REST APIs with FastAPI or Flask and integrate AI services into products.
- Deploy models on AWS / Azure / GCP using Docker and Kubernetes; set up CI/CD and MLOps practices.
- Work with SQL and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB) and Redis caching.

Required Skills
- Strong programming skills in Python.
- Hands-on experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow.
- Solid understanding of Machine Learning, Deep Learning and NLP concepts.
- Experience with OpenAI, Gemini or Claude APIs.
- Familiarity with Git, Linux and Agile development.

Good to Have
- Knowledge of Computer Vision and OCR.
- Experience with Kafka or Spark for data pipelines.
- Exposure to MLflow or Weights & Biases.
- Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
